shader_compile_failures.error: '.' : can't read from gl_WorkGroupSize before a fixed workgroup size has been declared
shader_compile_failures.root_cause: Shader reads gl_WorkGroupSize.x with no local_size layout declaration; glslangValidator 12.0.0 on the x86 dev box accepted it (same bug class as the 2026-09-03 fused RoPE incident in AGENTS.md).
shader_compile_failures.fix: layout(local_size_x = 256) in; (256 = kComputeThreadsPerGroup in compute.h, the group size every host dispatch uses)
shader_compile_failures.evidence: receipts-m1/03-build.log (failure), receipts-m1/03-build.3.log (green build after fix, NINJA-DONE-EXIT-0, zero FAILED lines)

top_defects_for_main.defect: Validation-layer teardown wedge: with VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation active, processes that finish work then destroy the device hang (reduce_ops) or abort (runtime_tests children that reopen the device time out with code -2). All in-test assertions pass; the failure is strictly in destroy/reopen paths.

complex64 bit-level mismatch: vjp of a complex gradient produces a value that prints as -3.2-0.4j on both sides but CHECK_EQ fails; Honeykrisp-only (passes on llvmpipe same machine). Suspect complex abs/mul conjugation path or FMA contraction in the complex elementwise shader.

quantize affine bit mismatch vs pinned Metal-source reference: exactly 1 of 16542 words differs (98174014 vs 98239550). Honeykrisp-only. Rounding-mode or fused multiply-add divergence in the quantize kernel.

Named-error contract broken on aarch64/GCC16 builds: expected exceptions are not thrown (test_error_contract.cpp:56 REQUIRE(false)) and error-message substrings do not match (string::npos both sides in quantized matmul pinning). Crashes (null shared_ptr<Primitive> deref) on the same error paths. Reproduces on both M1 devices -> not GPU; likely uninitialized/error-object lifetime behavior differing under GCC 16.1.1 aarch64.

Cross-platform pre-existing numeric failures (bool max/min reductions, bool/uint64 sign, bitwise shift, random bits): identical failures on llvmpipe dev box and M1; not M1 regressions but they gate the battery green.
test_fast_sdpa python segfault on aarch64 builds (both devices); dev box times out instead. Different mode than dev box, blocks ~18 upstream py files after it under the pinned protocol.
